text.p: Sichuan Changhong Electric Appliances Co Ltd, China's largest colour television maker, had record sales of 12.55 billion yuan ($1.5 billion) in 1996, up from 8 billion yuan in 1995, Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The former munitions manufacturer produced and sold more than 4.8 million colour television sets in 1996, up from 3.05 million in 1995, Xinhua said.
Changhong, based in Mianyang city in northwestern Shaanxi province, has been China's top colour television producer since 1989, it said.
It invested 300 million yuan in recent years to upgrade its technology and equipment, Xinhua said.
Changhong slashed its prices last year, boosting its market share to 26 percent by end-1996 from 16 percent at the beginning of the year, the agency said. It gave no further details.
